name: ActivityTimeline
tagline: Activity Timeline shows emails, phone calls, meetings, tasks, notes and site visits as a timeline instead of a long list.
description: Activity Timeline shows emails, phone calls, meetings, tasks, notes and site visits as a timeline instead of a long list. Each activity is a card with a coloured icon for its type, a friendly date ("Today 15:30", "Yesterday", "In 3 days"), its status, owner, the customer or case it relates to and a short preview of the notes.
features: KPI tiles (open, overdue, due soon, completed) that filter
Overdue / due-soon business rules, expandable details
Open record and Mark complete quick actions
A designed phone layout and selection / action outputs
